title: Canonical public-family typed data payload schemas
description: Planning artifact. API typed payload contracts with canonical data.type substitution, plus the explicit target requirement that URL/document references and file attachments identify their owning message. Conditional classification, trusted event-to-message provenance, producer authority and authorization remain outside JSON Schema.

x-profiles.primary: API typed producer/valid-source payload contract. Root oneOf enumerates this profile.
x-profiles.public: Use each x-targets.readProfiles.public ref after existing authorization projection and only with the stated eligibility. Invalid authorized rows retain the explicit legacy/unprojectable page member.
x-profiles.diagnostic: Use each x-targets.readProfiles.diagnostic ref only after the authorized diagnostic projection.
x-profiles.agui: Separate existing wire profile and adapter; no AG-UI wire schema is replaced by this bundle.

x-excluded.reason: Blocked vocabulary mapping; no normative canonical schema is approved.

x-unknownAndReserved: Reserved sources and UNKNOWN have no canonical target and are excluded. Open record/unknown values are represented as unconstrained JSON, without invented nested fields.

x-gaps.disposition: Preserve source acceptance; do not invent requiredness.
x-gaps.finding: Bare Zod unknown accepts absent keys. content and delta are therefore properties with unconstrained JSON schemas, absent from required.

x-gaps.disposition: Keep AG-UI adapter validation separate; these typed schemas do not redefine the AG-UI wire profile.
x-gaps.finding: Public AG-UI requires contentId on text content/end and constrains state delta to an object or JSON Patch operation array. Typed payload schemas intentionally retain optional contentId and opaque delta.

x-gaps.disposition: Preserve event identity, count and cursor in the explicit legacy/unprojectable member whenever the authorized payload fails the selected typed schema; do not fabricate required fields or globally loosen schemas.
x-gaps.finding: Current total projection can serve malformed known payloads and type-only degraded rows with unrecoverableFields. The primary typed schemas cover valid canonical source contracts, not every historical or redacted served row.

x-gaps.disposition: Apply existing public metadata allowlist before schema validation; schema acceptance does not grant permission to publish a field.
x-gaps.finding: The typed metadata contract is an open record. Public egress filters it to an allowlist without validating each copied value; diagnostic access and producer contracts differ from public visibility.

x-gaps.disposition: Preserve the authorized normalized read payload. The typed source schema remains permissive where the API writer accepts omission.
x-gaps.finding: Current read projection strips result/is_error aliases and supplies content:null for absent content; isError remains true, false or null. No boolean default to false is introduced.

x-verification.method: Executed pinned API payload.ts and compared its Zod acceptance with the saved Draft 2020-12 schemas over generated JSON fixtures and adversarial field mutations.
x-verification.limitations: No runtime, AG-UI adapter, authorization integration, staging or production compatibility execution. The runtime read companions have source evidence and direct schema validation; trusted redaction provenance remains a representation gate.

RUNTIME_EVENT_RECORDED.disposition: Reserved legacy carrier. Preserve the authorized source type, payload, persisted identity and cursor without assigning a generic canonical runtime event.
RUNTIME_EVENT_RECORDED.visibility: Reapply the existing nested/private source visibility policy. The opaque body alone does not establish provenance or public permission.
RUNTIME_EVENT_RECORDED.schemaStatus: No canonical payload schema is registered for this source.
